topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Well, Mark fit himself a fine scare when he dug up that old chest in the common lands, didn’t he? Never seen its like, and he’s lived here longer than anyone can remember. Filled with oddments and tales of times past, it is. I reckon it must’ve been some wayward traveler who fancied a bit of a jest, or maybe a feast day long forgotten. I told him, "Mark, this here is a bit of history, and we ought to show it to all, a fine find indeed." So we did. The whole village gathered, and there we were, telling stories old and new, the young ones listening wide-eyed. A good day, a good day, it was.
